CUT-A-DOR 1.2.1 — RELEASE TEST SCOPE / 18 OCTOBER 2026
Released image is unchanged from the owner-tested FM-1_7010201 package.
SHA256 5d4be92061cc5bf1396d3ff599ac3a1ef9ec1261afe003b74e32f4298307f614

OWNER REPORT
The owner reports that the latest functions work on the FM-1. This is a normal
use acceptance report, not a measured certification of every MIDI setup, every
bank transfer or deliberate power-loss/chip-recovery scenario.

SOFTWARE / PACKAGE
32,625,436 core assertions; 168,690 MIDI checks; ASan/UBSan engine and UI suite;
actual project Save/load audio comparison; 2,710 interrupted project writes;
all 27 keys in three modes tested for Setup/MIDI routing; duplicate panel map
rejection; help/long press/mixer/step/sample bank tests; WebAssembly and AudioWorklet
at 44.1/48/96 kHz; project/bank checksums; legacy imports; WAV export.
30-minute offline audio simulation: 79,380,000 frames, no timing drift or command/
MIDI queue loss. This is simulated duration, not a measured physical endurance run.
Installer/loader and recovery boundary tests use mock devices, never destructive
hardware tests. Identity, package CRCs, payload and padding match the compiled binary.
App 551636 bytes, slot headroom 29928 bytes. RAM 36756 / 98304, pool 265728 / 344064.

EDITOR BOUNDARY
Browser pattern editing, sound audition/assignment, WAV import, bank packing,
project Save/Open, FX tape and WAV bounce are local. USB tools upload selected
sound banks and export the device project. No project upload or live hardware
pattern editor is claimed. A device update is a separate explicit operation.

RELEASE WEBSITE CHECKS
Actual Chrome: engine start/stop, New Beat, step accents, lane level and curated
bank loading checked. Project download created and checksum validated. WAV bounce downloaded and validated
as mono 44.1 kHz / 16-bit, 460174 frames for four bars at 92 BPM. MIDI editor
simulation covers identity, exclusive tab lock, bank validation/chunks/commit/abort,
project size and chunk validation, concurrent operation rejection and disconnect.
Installer DOM simulation and rescue simulation passed. Physical USB bank transfers
and destructive recovery scenarios are not claimed as newly tested.
